attributes.name: The Eel
attributes.powers:
Before you act, The Eel deals 1d4 Structural damage to your ship.

While you act, all damage dealt by The Eel is Poison damage.

"A bit of poison here, a well-placed bomb there - sounds like the perfect formula for disaster to me!" -Myskur Marquardt, a.k.a. The Eel
